key: Integrator with Wrapped State (Discrete or Continuous)
title: Integrator with Wrapped State (Discrete or Continuous)
text: 具有环绕状态的离散时间或连续时间积分器，输入 1 路、输出 1 路；按 {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间；{Wrapped state upper limit} 指定状态上限 2*pi、{Wrapped state lower limit} 指定状态下限、{Initial condition} 指定状态初始值，按实例取值。

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: 模块采样时间 -1 (default) | 0 | positive scalar
